nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used throughout the system for authorization via allow/onlyAdmin/onlyOwner modifiers and for owner/validator identity.
Miner-influenced time value (now/block.timestamp) driving reward windows, schain creation, lockups and rotations.
Mapping of contract name hash to deployed contract address; resolved addresses are trusted without verification of the returned code in the allow modifiers.
Per-holder amount of slashed/locked tokens in the Punisher contract.
Array of all delegation records; index is used as delegationId and never deleted.
PartialDifferences.Value per validator tracking delegated amounts.
PartialDifferences.Sequence per validator tracking effective (stake-multiplied) delegated amounts.
Accumulated bounty pool for the current epoch; reduced on each bounty payment.
Global statistic of effective delegated amounts used as divisor when computing bounties.
Array of all registered node records including public keys, statuses and reward dates.
Per-node free space bookkeeping used for schain placement.
validatorId => month => bounty amount paid to validators.
Mapping of schainId to Schain struct holding owner, lifetime, deposit and start data.
Mapping validatorId => Validator struct (address, feeRate, minimum delegation, etc.).
Per-holder locked token amount during the token launch period.
Removes stake from a validator and its delegations; gated by allow("SkaleDKG") and performs an external confiscate call before emitting the event.
Admin-only function that reduces/deletes _locked[holder]; guarded by onlyAdmin.
Adds slashed amounts to _locked[holder]; callable only by the DelegationController contract.
Triggers processAllSlashes on the DelegationController and returns _locked[wallet].
Creates a delegation proposal; uses msg.sender as holder, reads token balances and can emit slashing signals via external calls into Punisher.
Validator accepts a proposal; updates statistics and calls TokenLaunchLocker/BountyV2 handlers.
Requests undelegation and removes amounts from delegated and effective-delegated accounting.
Reduces delegated values for a validator, writes the slashing log and notifies BountyV2; callable only by Punisher.
Aggregates penalties and performs external Punisher.handleSlash calls, creating a cross-contract reentrancy surface.
Applies pending slashes to a holder and forwards the resulting signals.
Returns delegated-by-holder plus locked-in-pending amounts for a wallet.
Validates node ownership/time and pays the bounty via _payBounty.
Mints the bounty to the Distributor through an external IMintableToken.mint call.
ERC777 receive hook gated by allow("SkaleToken"); forwards userData to Schains.addSchain.
Initiates node exit; permission checks combine owner, node owner and validator identity; uses now for finish time.
Withdraws earned bounty to an arbitrary destination address via IERC20.transfer.
Withdraws validator fees to an arbitrary destination address via IERC20.transfer.
Splits an incoming bounty into fee and delegator bounty and stores them by month.
Computes and reduces the bounty for a node using current timestamp, epoch pool and effective delegated sums.
Creates a schain from SkaleManager-supplied data; checks now against schainCreationTimeStamp and deposit vs price.
Deletes an schain owned by `from`, returns space to nodes and cleans internal structures.
Registers a node; verifies IP/name/port and derives the owner address from the public key.
Reducer of node free space; restricted to NodeRotation/SchainsInternal and updates spaceOfNodes.
Finalizes node exit, deletes node data and notifies BountyV2.handleNodeRemoving.
Increases _locked[holder]; callable only by TokenLaunchManager.
Caps the newly delegated amount by the current locked amount and records delegation amounts.
Computes currently locked tokens; may unlock when proof-of-use conditions and lock end time are met.
Derives a lock end timestamp from a month index and lock-up period using the date library.
Registers a validator bound to msg.sender with a fee rate and minimum delegation amount.
Finalizes the in-progress BLS public key for a schain; callable only by SkaleDKG.
Pseudo-randomly selects a replacement node using blockhash-derived randomness and removes its space.
Writes schain name/owner/timestamps into SchainsInternal.schains; callable only by Schains.
Initializer granting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender and wiring the ContractManager.
Sends ETH with recipient.call{value:amount}("") forwarding all available gas.
Checked addition helper used to prevent arithmetic overflow in accounting updates.
Recovers a signer from a signature; used to authorize node address linking against msg.sender.
Removes an schain from owner lists and decrements the numberOfSchains counter.
Marks a node as Left and adjusts active/leaving/left node counters with unchecked arithmetic.
Iterates over registered lockers performing external getAndUpdateLockedAmount calls and summing results.
External call Punisher.slash -> DelegationController.confiscate resolved through ContractManager before state finalization/event emission.
External mint call from SkaleManager._payBounty to the SkaleToken/Distributor.
External ERC20 transfer from Distributor withdraw functions to an attacker-chosen destination.
External call from DelegationController._sendSlashingSignals into Punisher.handleSlash while slashing state may be mid-update.
External call from TokenState into each registered locker contract.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue forwarding all gas.
Assembly staticcall to the bn256 precompiled contracts (0x05,0x07,0x08) used for BLS verification.
Node selection uses uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(block.number-1), id))) which is miner-influenceable.
uint64 numberOfSchains counter is decremented without overflow/underflow protection.
numberOfActiveNodes/numberOfLeavingNodes/numberOfLeftNodes are incremented/decremented with plain arithmetic.
Validator identifier supplied to Punisher.slash.
Slash amount supplied to Punisher.slash.
Holder address whose locked tokens are forgiven.
Amount forgiven for the holder.
Target validator identifier for a new delegation.
Delegated token amount for a new delegation.
Node index for which a bounty is claimed.
Node owner address derived by SkaleManager from the caller.
NodeCreationParams struct with name, ip, publicIp, port, publicKey and nonce.
Running penalty accumulator grouped per holder before the external handleSlash call.
DelegationController reference resolved from ContractManager inside slash.
Computed bounty amount before it is subtracted from the epoch pool.
Validator fee split of the distributed bounty (amount.mul(feeRate).div(1000)).
Current month obtained from TimeHelpers used for delegated-amount updates.

edges.reason: Punisher.slash is gated by allow("SkaleDKG") which compares msg.sender to a ContractManager-resolved address.
Punisher.forgive is gated by onlyAdmin, which evaluates roles for msg.sender.
delegate uses msg.sender as the delegation holder and balance owner.
acceptPendingDelegation verifies msg.sender is the validator address of the delegation.
requestUndelegation requires msg.sender to be the holder or the validator.
SkaleManager.getBounty requires nodes.isNodeExist(msg.sender,nodeIndex).
SkaleManager.tokensReceived is gated by allow("SkaleToken") on msg.sender.
withdrawFee resolves the validator id from msg.sender before transferring fees.
createNode receives the owner address derived by SkaleManager from msg.sender.
Nodes.removeSpaceFromNode is gated by allowTwo on msg.sender.
TokenLaunchLocker.lock is gated by allow("TokenLaunchManager") on msg.sender.
registerValidator binds msg.sender as validatorAddress and checks it is not already registered.
selectNodeToGroup is gated by allowThree on msg.sender.
Permissions.initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender.
ECDSA.recover output is compared against msg.sender/nodeAddress when linking node addresses.
nodeExit adds rotationDelay to now to compute the node finish time.
calculateBounty requires now to be at or past the next reward timestamp.
addSchain requires now >= schainCreationTimeStamp.
completeExit emits block.timestamp in the ExitCompleted event.
getAndUpdateLockedAmount compares proof-of-use lock end time to now before unlocking.
calculateProofOfUseLockEndTime derives timestamps from month indices.
allow modifier resolves the authorized caller from contractManager.contracts.
slash invokes DelegationController.confiscate before emitting the Slash event.
slash performs an external confiscate call on a ContractManager-resolved address.
forgive reduces or deletes _locked[holder].
handleSlash increases _locked[holder] by the slashed amount.
handleSlash uses SafeMath.add for the locked amount update.
_getAndUpdateLockedAmount triggers processAllSlashes before reading locked amounts.
_getAndUpdateLockedAmount returns the locked amount derived from the DelegationController.
delegate pushes a new Delegation into the delegations array.
delegate processes and sends slashing signals to the Punisher via _sendSlashingSignals.
acceptPendingDelegation updates effective-delegated sequences for the validator.
acceptPendingDelegation calls TokenLaunchLocker.handleDelegationAdd.
requestUndelegation removes amounts from _delegatedToValidator.
confiscate reduces _delegatedToValidator for the slashed validator.
confiscate reduces the effective delegated sequence for the validator.
confiscate notifies BountyV2 to adjust the global effective delegated sum.
_sendSlashingSignals performs external Punisher.handleSlash calls.
processAllSlashes forwards the produced signals to _sendSlashingSignals.
getBounty calls _payBounty when the calculated bounty is greater than zero.
_payBounty mints tokens through an external IMintableToken.mint call.
tokensReceived forwards userData to Schains.addSchain.
withdrawBounty reads _bountyPaid through getAndUpdateEarnedBountyAmountOf.
withdrawBounty performs an external ERC20 transfer to a caller-supplied destination.
withdrawFee performs an external ERC20 transfer to a caller-supplied destination.
_distributeBounty writes _bountyPaid[validatorId][currentMonth].
calculateBounty checks now against the node next reward timestamp.
calculateBounty subtracts the paid bounty from _epochPool.
calculateBounty divides the epoch pool by the global effective delegated sum.
addSchain compares now to schainCreationTimeStamp.
addSchain initializes the schain through SchainsInternal.initializeSchain.
deleteSchain returns space to nodes via the Nodes contract.
createNode pushes a new Node struct into nodes.
createNode updates spaceOfNodes and spaceToNodes for the new node.
removeSpaceFromNode moves the node to a new space map entry.
completeExit deletes node data from the nodes array.
lock increases TokenLaunchLocker._locked[holder].
lock uses SafeMath.add for the locked amount update.
handleDelegationAdd reads _locked to bound the newly delegated amount.
getAndUpdateLockedAmount compares the proof-of-use lock end time to now.
getAndUpdateLockedAmount queries the DelegationController for locked pending amounts.
getAndUpdateLockedAmount calls calculateProofOfUseLockEndTime to decide unlocking.
registerValidator stores a Validator struct keyed by the new validatorId.
finalizePublicKey relies on G2 validation paths backed by bn256 precompiles.
selectNodeToGroup removes space from the pseudo-randomly selected node.
selectNodeToGroup derives the chosen node from blockhash-based randomness.
initializeSchain writes name, owner, timestamps and deposit into SchainsInternal.schains.
sendValue performs a low-level recipient.call{value:amount} forwarding all gas.
removeSchain decrements the numberOfSchains counter with unchecked arithmetic.
_setNodeLeft adjusts active/leaving/left counters with plain increment/decrement.
TokenState loops over lockers performing external getAndUpdateLockedAmount calls.
Punisher.handleSlash re-enters locked state updates while slashing signals are delivered.
Locker callback re-enters TokenLaunchLocker.getAndUpdateLockedAmount during token state aggregation.

normalization_plan.reason: Validator id parameter is only meaningful within Punisher.slash and should fold into its function node.
Slash amount parameter is consumed by Punisher.slash when calling confiscate.
Holder parameter is only used inside Punisher.forgive to index _locked.
Forgiven amount parameter is only used inside Punisher.forgive.
Validator id argument flows only through the delegate function body.
Delegated amount argument flows only through the delegate function body.
Node index parameter is used only within SkaleManager.getBounty.
Owner address parameter is consumed by Nodes.createNode.
NodeCreationParams struct is only used inside Nodes.createNode validation and storage.
Local accumulator only exists during the slashing-signal delivery loop.
Local contract reference is used solely to perform the external confiscate call.
Local bounty variable is only produced and consumed inside calculateBounty.
Local fee split variable is only used inside _distributeBounty.
Local current month value is only used within getAndUpdateLockedAmount.
